purpose: Recover historical Lotto Model A, Model C, and contrarian definitions without hindsight reconstruction.
search_scope: ChatGPT Library and prior conversation files
tracked related S001-S008, V3 and V4 source lineage

missing_for_executable_identity: exact pair score implementation for the weighted A

legacy_C.recovered_rule: A pattern signals are filtered/combined only after repeated B holdout validation; do not arbitrarily remove extreme-looking structures.
legacy_C.alternate_contemporaneous_wording: A and B common-support signals only; later project guidance clarified A/B/C should remain independently modeled rather than blindly mixed.

legacy_contrarian.recovered_rule: Keep atypical structures such as consecutive numbers, range concentration, odd/even skew, repeated endings and extreme sums as separately validated opposite-hypothesis candidates instead of excluding them for aesthetics.

related_executable_lineage.identity_rule: Related later models must not be relabelled as the historical A/C/contrarian models.

contradictory_historical_execution_claim: PRESENT; late-September assistant messages contain both claimed numerical backtests and explicit statements that A/B/C had not actually been run. Therefore those claims are not accepted as authoritative execution evidence.
reconstruction_policy: No missing formula, normalization, weight, tie-break, or selection rule was invented.
